name: Host input limiter and LDO
constraints: Near raw host 5V entry, inside x<87 corridor; C110 at U95 IN, R110 at ILIM; C111/C112 at LDO pins.

name: Shared supervisor and Schmitt guard
constraints: Compact common RESET net ≤50pF; divider bottoms and CT capacitors locally grounded, avoid L1/L20 switch nodes. Sense rails at the loads, not upstream of isolation.

name: Host-output disable and bus hold-up
constraints: Between RP support and U44–U47 corridor; U94 near XRDY/IRQ connector routing, C113 near U44/U45 bus-rail loads. Supervisor-to-OE direct route; no shared switching-return neck.

name: Main-rail hold-up
constraints: Adjacent to main regulator output/power distribution, outside switch node and feedback loop. Keep original C7/C8/L1 cell unchanged.

name: RP reset clamp and released-control conditioning
constraints: Near RP_RUN and recovery bias; short collector route; bypass at buffer VCC.

name: Request conditioning
constraints: Near U84/U86/U82 request/clock logic and RP source pins. R64 must bias raw signals, not conditioned outputs.

name: Host open-collector receive conditioning
constraints: Immediately upstream of U43 reset/BERR/DTACK inputs; keep noisy edge-corridor returns out of threshold path.

name: Consolidated combinational logic
constraints: Use vacated gate rows; U66 near address-buffer outputs, U71 toward byte OE and U93; U64 balances six distributed loads. Bypasses move with packages in next stage.

name: SD bias array
constraints: Close to J30/ESP SD signal paths with R41; maintain card insertion access.

name: Buck AVIN bypass
suggested_region_mm: at U5 AVIN with local ground
constraints: Add to U5 group; 5V_MAIN only, outside switch-node copper.
